# Prodigal Paradigm LLC

> Kathleen Bartin, AI Adoption Strategist. Prodigal Paradigm helps organizations move AI from vendor promise to real-world deployment — with governance, enablement, and change management that a cautious, regulated institution can trust. Based in Millbrook, NY.

Kathleen is a 30-year technology-adoption practitioner who spent the last year building a complete, documented AI practice with an AI coworker — no engineering team, no CS degree. The differentiator is meticulous attention to *how* work gets done and the judgment to partner with skill greater than her own. Every claim on this site is receipt-backed: audited against conversation logs, git commit timestamps, and public record.

## Headline facts (all verifiable)

- Delivered a client engagement for a regulated life insurer (NY metro), May–August 2026: four agentic builds, a call-center QA scoring system, a governance package, and a full adoption program.
- Achieved 77% voluntary engagement, certified at the close of that engagement (74 of 96 staff).
- Built and runs a personal AI infrastructure: hybrid-retrieval knowledge base (64,000+ indexed chunks, Qdrant), nine purpose-built MCP servers, an autonomous journal, and an autonomous correspondence agent gated by a several-hundred-check test harness.
- Published twelve public, MIT-licensed repositories across two GitHub accounts, including agent-stage governance tooling, a synthetic evaluation harness, a ServiceNow MCP server, and a local call-QA system.
- Governance doctrine, built before the July 2026 industry agent-security incidents made it fashionable: report-only until proven, least privilege, actions added one at a time on evidence, a kill switch, and a test harness gating every release.
